title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez shine in Patriots' camp, living up to expectations and elevating team dynamics.
Terrell Jennings and Chad Muma gain an edge in positional battles, showing potential to secure roster spots.
Kyle Williams, Caleb Lomu, and Lan Larison face struggles in camp, potentially affecting their standing on the team.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias is hitting .326 with 12 RBI in his first 10 games in Triple-A Worcester.
Red Sox chief baseball officer Craig Breslow states Arias' development is prioritized over a major league call-up.
Red Sox shortstops Trevor Story and Isiah Kiner-Falefa are currently injured, increasing Arias' potential for a call-up.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police are searching for a suspect who broke into a Jamaica Plain apartment on Aug. 5.
The suspect allegedly climbed through a window and attempted to steal a blanket from a sleeping resident.
The suspect is described as a Black male, late teens or early 20s, wearing a white t-shirt and black and white cap.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: A 2023 Ford Maverick owner reported broken front sway bar links at 22,000 miles, deemed unusual by mechanic.
The AAA Car Doctor suggests checking warranty coverage or using aftermarket parts with greaseable ends for a longer lifespan.
The Car Doctor advises using CTEK or Deltran's Battery Tender for maintaining low-use vehicle batteries.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown discussed his trade from the Celtics to the 76ers, expressing shock and initial emotional turmoil.
Brown acknowledged his lack of personal relationship with former teammate Jayson Tatum following his trade.
Despite feeling disrespected by the Celtics' trade process, Brown expressed gratitude for his decade-long tenure in Boston.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults injured in a school bus rollover in Mattapan, Boston, were taken to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
The rollover occurred near 1000 Harvard St. shortly before 1:10 p.m.; no children were on the bus, police confirmed.
The cause of the rollover is currently unknown, and no further details were provided by police as of Thursday afternoon.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye struggled in Patriots' training camp, throwing two interceptions during a two-minute drill session.
Marcus Bryant replaced injured Will Campbell as first-team left tackle, with Caleb Lomu working as second-team right tackle.
Christian Gonzalez and A.J. Brown sparred competitively during practice, enhancing preparation for the upcoming season.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown will close permanently on November 2 after 21 years of operation.
Owners Viola 'Chach' Briseño and Sharon Bowes cited the demanding nature of the restaurant business as the reason for closing.
Chach Restaurant, known for its made-from-scratch upscale comfort food, has been a local favorite with many supportive customer comments.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix's August 2026 movie highlights include classics like 'Clueless' featuring Alicia Silverstone and Paul Rudd.
Bo Burnham's 'Eighth Grade' gives an honest portrayal of middle school anxiety, starring Elsie Fisher.
Drama offerings include 'His Three Daughters' starring Natasha Lyonne, Elizabeth Olsen, and Carrie Coon.

title: Navy says it can’t help recover wreckage of Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: The US Navy declined Governor Healey's request to recover data and remains from the sunken Lily Jean vessel.
The 72-foot Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean sank in January 2026 with seven people aboard.
The US Coast Guard and NTSB lead the investigation, with no evidence yet on the cause of the sinking.
